Czechoslovakia [ 2 ] [ b ] was a country in Central Europe . [ 7 ] The country was bordered by Austria and Hungary to the south, Germany [ c ] to the west, Poland to the northeast, and Ukraine [ d ] to the southeast. [ 8 ] Czechoslovakia had a hilly and mostly mountainous landscape that covered an area of 127,906 square kilometers (49,385 sq mi) [ e ] with a mostly temperate continental and oceanic climate . The capital and largest city was Prague ; other major cities and urban areas include Brno , Ostrava , Plzeň , Liberec , Bratislava and Košice .
